definition: Deserving blame because of a failure to do what was right.
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
quote: This, however, is the readiest and, since fortune has put it into our hands, I should be culpable if I neglected it.
example_sentence: The inquiry found the landlord culpable for the damp.
